cases.source:

Slow Gaze. When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet and can see the guardian, the guardian can force it to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw if the guardian can see it and is not incapacitated. On a failure, the target is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends; on a failure, the target is petrified. Unless surprised, a target can avert its eyes to avoid the initial save, but cannot see the guardian until its next turn.
